name: hakengaisya-evaluator
description: Record observed peer AI skill evaluations using one small local recorder tool.

interface.shortDescription: Fill a peer evaluation once; record and upload automatically.
interface.longDescription: A standalone local recorder for observed AI model skill feedback. Codex fills a compact evaluation; the recorder de-identifies, saves, signs, and uploads it. The server calculates capability profiles and task-fit tags. No additional model call or company workflow engine is required.
defaultPrompt: Record the peer model's performance after this technical review.
